title: Base64 encoding and decoding — fast_base64_encode
text: Standard (RFC 4648 section 4) URL-safe (section 5) Base64. Decoding strict: whitespace, nothing outside selected alphabet, padding either complete absent, unused trailing bits zero, every accepted input exactly one encoding.

title: Base64 encoding and decoding — fast_base64_encode
text: fast_base64_encode() returns character vector. fast_base64_decode() returns list raw vectors, one per element x, NULL element NA valid Base64.

what: zufast: Fast Portable C Primitives for Parsing and Formatting Data — zufast-package
title: zufast: Fast Portable C Primitives for Parsing and Formatting Data — zufast-package
text: header-library small, fast, portable C99 primitives converting external text bytes native values back: correctly rounded number parsing, shortest round-trip number formatting, ISO 8601 dates timestamps, booleans, UUIDs, hexadecimal Base64, XXH3 hashing, half-precision floats, endian helpers UTF-8 validation. packages use 'LinkingTo' alone; R functions exist test, benchmark demonstrate C layer.

title: zufast (development version)
text: Header-foundation: <zufast.h>, zufast/version.h zufast/status.h, consumed LinkingTo: zufast alone. fast_info() reports compiled header version. zufast/literal.h: zuf_parse_bool() per-spelling flags, zuf_equals(), zuf_equals_ci(), zuf_skip_space(), zuf_trim_space(). zufast/bits.h: binary16 bfloat16 conversion, fits predicates, endian loads, stores byte swaps. zufast/utf8.h fast_utf8_valid(): UTF-8 validation code-point counting Hoehrmann’s DFA. zufast/hex.h, zufast/base64.h zufast/uuid.h: hex strict Base64 (standard URL alphabets, optional padding) codecs UUID parsing formatting; fast_hex_encode(), fast_hex_decode(), fast_base64_encode() fast_base64_decode(). zufast/datetime.h: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date timestamp parsing fields, Neri-Schneider calendar arithmetic exact whole int32_t day range, RFC 3339 formatting; fast_parse_date(), fast_parse_datetime(), fast_datetime_fields() fast_format_datetime().
